question: For how long and under what condition must one practice in order to take up the ochre robe described here?
premises: One who practices should do so from six months onward.
The object of that practice is the ochre robe.
That ochre robe is characterized as free from bondage.
inference: After six months of practice, one who is qualified should take up the ochre robe that is free from bondage.
uncertainties: The verse does not state the full fruit of taking up that robe.
plain_english: One who indeed should practice for six months should take up the ochre robe free from bondage.
